messages:
anita: heads-up — we observed a perf regression after kernel v2.11 on mixed-precision routing. Qwen-2 16k runs dropped ~12% throughput when prefix lengths > 4k.
jun: can you paste the numbers?
anita: baseline (v2.10, hybrid fp8/int4): 1340 tok/s avg @ batch=8 seq=16k, kv-hit ~0.78. after v2.11: 1180 tok/s, tail latency +18%.
oliver: hmm that's sizable. v2.11 changed the kernel-selection heuristic (favoring int4 for attention when seq<6k) — maybe we mispredicted fp8 slow paths for long prefixes.
maria: also saw higher memory churn on the same runs — KV cache write spikes. might be related to the new kv-copy alignment change.
ciara: do we have per-layer kernel choice traces for those runs? I want to see where fallback happens.
anita: attaching a small paste of our local profile snippet (trimmed):
```
-- run: qwen-2-16k, batch=8
attn_kernel_choices: [fp8, fp8, int4, int4, int4, fp8,fp8]
kv_write_ms: 430ms avg
kv_read_ms: 120ms avg
token_throughput: 1180 tok/s
```
jun: interesting pattern — middle layers picked int4 aggressively. on Mistral we didn't see as much drop. maybe qwen attention matmul favors fp8 at mid layers.
oliver: proposed mitigation: seq-aware kernel-decider that uses two signals: predicted kv-hit probability (from prefix histogram) and measured per-layer flop density. if predicted kv-hit > 0.6 and seq>8k, bias toward fp8 for attention kernels.
ciara: +1. also want a live calibration sampler that records real quantization scale drift during warmup (first 200 tokens) and pushes a soft override to kernel-decider. that should catch model-specific quirks.
maria: can we express the policy as a tiny JSON/YAML config so infra can run A/B? e.g.
```
policy_name: qwen-longprefix-fallback
signals:
  - kv_hit_threshold: 0.6
  - seq_threshold: 8000
  - prefer_fp8_layers: [0..3, 10..13]
actions:
  - set_attention_kernel: fp8
  - fallback_on_mispred: true
```
jun: look good. for experiments we should also track quality delta (perplexity on eval prompts) — int4 drift could be small but NLU-sensitive. add eval hooks.
anita: perf-bot ran a quick synthetic canary: v2.11 + seq-aware-decider prototype gives throughput 1290 tok/s (batch=8 seq=16k) — so up from 1180 but still shy of 1340 baseline.
perf-bot: canary summary: before: 1180 tok/s, after-proto: 1290 tok/s, reference (v2.10): 1340 tok/s.
oliver: that's promising. can we instrument KV cache eviction behavior? if align change caused more frequent evictions that would explain writes.
ciara: yes — will add a lightweight trace that logs kv_eviction_count per-minute and avg_kv_segment_size. also add a small sample of activations to feed calibrator.
maria: action items: 1) ciara to build live calibrator + trace (ETA 2d). 2) oliver to add seq-aware kernel-decider config + rollout flag (ETA 3d). 3) jun and anita to run cross-model sweep on Llama-3 and Mistral-7B to verify generalization (ETA 4d).
anita: sharing initial quant_profile draft for Qwen/Mistral/Llama that we used for the protos — please treat as experiment config: 
```
quant_profiles:
  qwen-2-16k:
    attention: fp8-prefer
    matmul: int4-hybrid
    kv_copy_align: false
  mistral-7b:
    attention: fp8
    matmul: int8
    kv_copy_align: true
  llama-3-8k:
    attention: int4-safe
    matmul: int4
```
jun: thanks. small note: prefer_fp8 at attention isn't binary — we should rate-limit transitions per-minute to avoid oscillation. add cooldown.
ciara: will add cooldown=30s default.
oliver: also log the kernel-selection flip rate metric. helps debugging.
maria: OK let's run the A/B for a week on canary pool. volunteers to own rollout? @anita and @jun? :thumbsup:
anita: I can own canary runs + perf dashboard. will post results in this thread.
jun: I'll coordinate evals and the quality hooks.
ciara: I'll push the trace + calibrator branch to eng repo under `ml/kernel-decider-seq-aware`.
anita: thanks all — this should give us a clean, model-specific way to avoid regressions while keeping the cost wins of int4 where appropriate.
